title: Total and small RNA sequencing from submandibular gland tissue and blood of de novo Parkinson disease patients
description: Parkinson disease (PD) is the second most common neurodegenerative disorder, characterized by the accumulation of aggregated alpha-synuclein; however, the molecular mechanisms underlying its aggregation remain incompletely understood. The potential contribution of RNA to this process has not been fully investigated. In addition, studies based on post-mortem brain tissue are limited by RNA degradation associated with the post-mortem interval. Peripheral tissues such as the submandibular gland (SMG) exhibit alpha-synuclein pathology comparable to that observed in the substantia nigra, providing a useful alternative for studying disease-associated molecular signatures. Here, we present total and small RNA sequencing datasets generated from SMG tissue of drug-naive PD patients and age-matched disease-free controls. Fasting blood samples from the same individuals were also analyzed to enable comparison with SMG-derived profiles. These datasets may provide a useful resource for investigating RNA-based mechanisms and biomarkers associated with PD.
